slides.texte_overlay:
Things every man should
be able to fix himself

1. A flat tire

Jack, wrench, spare.
Twenty minutes, no tow truck.

2. A wobbly chair

Tighten the screws,
glue the joint. Done.

3. A clogged sink

A plunger and patience
before calling anyone.

4. Anything, after
learning how it works

Five minutes of curiosity
saves hours of waiting.
slides.texte_sophia:
4. Anything, after
learning how it works

I learn how things work
on the Sophia app.

slides.texte_overlay:
5. A loose button

Needle, thread, two minutes.

6. A squeaky door

A drop of oil on the hinge.
